sources.summary: Showcase your project at the 25th Tile of Spain Awards Have you designed a project where ceramic tiles take centre stage? The call for entries for the 25th Tile of Spain Awards is now open! If your project showcases the potential of Spanish ceramic tiles as an architectural material, we invite you to submit your entry in the Architecture or Interior Design categories. For twenty-five editions, the Tile of Spain Awards have recognised outstanding projects distinguished by their quality, innovation and excellence in the use of ceramic wall and floor tiles manufactured in Spain by ASCER member companies. Who can apply? Architects,
